description: Fetch a consolidated metrics snapshot for a single stock by ticker: identity (company, exchange, currency, sector, industry, country, ISIN), latest daily price (OHLCV), latest valuation (market cap, P/E, dividend yield, annual dividend per share), the most recent reported financials (revenue, gross/operating income, EBITDA, net income, diluted EPS, free & operating cash flow, total debt, cash, total assets, equity) and a short company description. Prices are in the listing's trading currency; financials in their own sourceCurrency. Use the listing ticker returned by search_stocks. US/European examples: AAPL, BMW, NESN. Most Asian listings keep their exchange suffix (6324.T, 0700.HK); some use bare codes (005930). Native or suffixed forms resolve only when one listing matches; search by company name or ISIN if unsure. Read-only.

ticker.description: The stock ticker as Bullrun lists it, e.g. "AAPL", "BMW", "NESN", "6324.T", "0700.HK" or "005930". A bare numeric code is resolved when exactly one listing matches.
